:::{#rem-cross-entropy-expected-surprisal}
#### Cross-entropy is an expected surprisal

By definition, the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $\crossentropyf{p}{q}$ is the average [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of the values drawn from $p$,
with each surprisal measured by $q$ as $-\log q(x)$.
By @cor-cross-entropy-entropy, measuring with $p$ itself gives the [entropy](#def-entropy).

:::
